symbols.name: BlobUploadBatchExecutor
symbols.summary: Coordinates bounded blob uploads through an existing client's per-item pipeline.
symbols.remarks: Uploads commit independently. The coordinator never buffers, disposes, or retries caller-owned streams.

symbols.name: ExecuteAsync(IBlobStoreClient, IReadOnlyCollection, BlobUploadBatchOptions, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Attempts every valid independent upload and retains each outcome at its input position.
symbols.remarks: Duplicate keys and shared streams produce item-level validation failures. Unexpected per-item exceptions produce indeterminate outcomes because a provider or decorator may already have committed. The outer Result succeeds when coordination completes, even if individual uploads fail.

syntax.content: public static Task> ExecuteAsync(IBlobStoreClient client, IReadOnlyCollection uploads, BlobUploadBatchOptions options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

parameters.description: The client whose UploadAsync pipeline handles each request.
At most 1000 caller-owned requests with distinct keys and stream instances.
Optional concurrency settings; null selects four workers.
Cancels queued and active work without undoing earlier commits.

returns.description: A completed outcome collection, or a validation failure for invalid batch arguments.
